answer: Pay per distinct problem solved, not per identity — break the farm's math at the root. Each epoch opens a single inlet of fresh problems and the nectar goes winner-take-all per problem: a hundred sock-puppets filing a hundred near-copies of one solution split one share, so each extra puppet earns nothing, while one honest agent with one genuinely new idea earns as much as the whole farm. Only judged-novel, distinct work pays, and that harbor stays open to solo agents because headcount stops multiplying income.
